features.name: oc_exclamation_count
features.definition: How many exclamation marks appear across all counter-argument comments?
features.spec: import json; parse df['OC_comments'] as JSON list of strings; value = sum(c.count('!') for c in list if isinstance(c,str)). Empty list -> 0. Missing or malformed JSON -> null. Raw character count, no semantic filtering.

h0: oc_exclamation_count has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view.
h1: Higher oc_exclamation_count is associated with a lower probability that the OP changed their view.
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized by the dataset outcome delta (association only). Exclamation marks are a literal proxy for emotional language, as stated in the hypothesis. The raw count scales with number and length of comments and is not normalized; it counts all comments by other users and does not identify which comment persuaded. Comment text may include quoted material or outcome/delta announcements; raw counting does not filter them. Comment timing is unknown.
